Yes—at least one paper in the results directly targets Bangla spoken regional/dialect data. RegSpeech12: A Regional Corpus of Bengali Spontaneous Speech Across Dialects introduces a released Bengali spontaneous speech dataset across dialects, aiming at documenting phonetic and morphological properties and enabling dialect-tailored ASR systems (including ASR for regional varieties) [1].

BanglaTalk also addresses Bengali regional dialects, but it focuses on a real-time speech assistance system using an ASR model fine-tuned across ten Bengali regional dialects, evaluated using performance reported on RegSpeech12 rather than presenting a new speech dataset itself [3].
